mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle, lowering discount rates applied to equity cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in < 60% of triggered instances during easing periods, or walk-forward Rank IC < 0.05 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 3.5% triggers investor concerns about labor market weakening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 20d returns remain non-negative when UNRATE crosses above 3.5%, or t-test p-value > 0.05 in such instances.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent growth in both GDPC1 (total demand) and HOUST (industrial production) signals robust economic momentum, amplifying equity valuations and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 20d returns not significantly positive (p > 0.05) when both proxies rise, or IC < 0.05 over 6-month windows.

mechanism_narrative: During a late-cycle expansion regime, rising INDPRO (supply) signals peak demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20d returns remain non-negative during late-cycle expansion when INDPRO increases, or IC > 0.05 over 12-month windows.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in RSAFS (retail sales) below 500 million signals weakening demand, prompting market concerns and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 20d returns not negative when RSAFS drops below 500, or t-test p-value > 0.05 in such instances.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent high labor participation (PAYEMS) and low unemployment (UNRATE) create conflicting signals, reducing market confidence and driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20d returns not negative when both proxies move in opposite directions, or IC < 0.05 over 6-month windows.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle, FEDFUNDS exceeding 2% signals aggressive rate hikes, compressing equity valuations and generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60d returns not negative when FEDFUNDS > 2.0, or IC > 0.05 over 2-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in GDPC1 (total demand) and RSAFS (retail sales) indicates robust economic activity, boosting equity valuations and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20d returns not positive when both proxies rise, or IC < 0.05 over 6-month windows.
